result_overview.clear.title_template: The current primary candidates are relatively clear
result_overview.clear.body_template: One candidate stands out relative to the others in these responses. Start with a recent event, notice what you most wanted to protect, then look for an exception.

result_overview.diffuse.body_template: Several candidates have support in these responses. Compare two settings and notice which motivations recur and which differences track your role, deadline, or information.

result_overview.low_quality.title_template: The current result has a quality boundary
result_overview.low_quality.body_template: These responses offer limited evidence for distinguishing candidates. Review how you understood the items and the circumstances in which you answered. You can take the 105-item form again when you can focus. Use the current scores to review this set of answers.
